title: Dynamic Chests
description: This mod introduces new chests to minecraft with various abilitys!
body:
# Dynamic Chests

Dynamic Chests expands Minecraft with unique chests that each have their own special mechanics, offering new ways to store, protect, and manage your items. Rather than simply increasing storage, every chest is designed to serve a distinct purpose while fitting naturally into survival gameplay.

# Current Chests (More to be added):
## 💀 Soul Chest

The Soul Chest protects your valuables after death. When you die, your inventory is transferred into the Soul Chest, allowing you to recover your items instead of searching for them at your death location.

## 🌑 Shadow Chest

The Shadow Chest blends seamlessly into its surroundings by copying the appearance of the block it is placed on, making it perfect for hidden bases, secret rooms, and creative builds.

## 🕳️ Void Chest

Need to permanently dispose of unwanted items? The Void Chest deletes anything placed inside it. To help prevent mistakes, items remain recoverable for 5 seconds before they are permanently destroyed.

### !!More to Come!!

Dynamic Chests is just getting started! New chest types with unique mechanics and gameplay features will be added in future updates, giving you even more ways to customize your storage and survival experience.
